ledger_row: Fit/derive capability predictor only from development worlds.
claim_boundary: This derives an architecture-name-free finite predictor only from theorem-generated development worlds. No held-family outcomes are visible to fitting, no family strengths/weaknesses are tested, and G6 is not claimed.

target_semantics.memory_exact: 1 iff retained state capacity meets the registered task distinction requirement
target_semantics.planning_exact: 1 iff both retained state and planning depth meet the registered obligation
target_semantics.coordination_exact: 1 iff communication distinctions meet the registered coordination requirement
target_semantics.verified_tool_exact: 1 iff both routed proposal coverage and verification coverage meet the registered proposal obligation

fit_rule: For each binary capability, form the componentwise-monotone lower envelope from dominated positive development worlds and upper envelope from dominating negative development worlds. Emit 1 or 0 only when the development corpus identifies the value; otherwise CANNOT_IDENTIFY.
strongest_parent: isotonic/monotone classification, partial-order concept learning, exact threshold identification
negative_twin: inject a held-family outcome or identity field into fitting; the protocol must reject the record before model construction
nearest_counterexample: outside the registered five-axis finite cube, monotonicity alone need not identify a unique capability value; the predictor must abstain rather than extrapolate
falsifier: Any fitted model consumes a forbidden held/identity field, disagrees with an exhaustive registered development world, or emits a determinate prediction where its monotone envelopes do not identify one value.
